svg.title: Figure 5-1. FTTI, detection and reaction budgets per safety goal against code-derived times (WP-S-04 §3.7, §4, §5)
svg.desc: For each fault class of §3.7 the budget bar shows the fault detection time interval, the fault reaction time interval and the margin up to the fault tolerant time interval, on a linear time axis from 0 to 1.2 s. Below it the code-derived times of §4 are drawn to the same scale for the original baseline 8b8c6ae (grey) and for the reference build bf6ce8c (amber, implemented but not verified on hardware). Red marks the part of a time beyond its budget. The EPS-fault siren of the reference build at up to 1.26 s worst case exceeds the SG-02 1 s warning budget (OI-8). Since panda c33343b (all builds) the siren after SoC heartbeat loss sounds about 0.56 s after the last heartbeat when authority was granted, within the budget; the 1 Hz path at 4 to 5 s is unchanged. No time has been measured.
